headline: Simpsons: Hit & Run might be making a comeback.
summary: Matt Groening hinted at a return for the cult classic game. He suggested the original game is 'coming back in some form'. Body language implied a potential project despite a showrunner's cautious note.

headline: Roleplay as a chatbot to mock AI's expense.
summary: 'Your AI Slop Bores Me' is a game to humorously interact with AI. Users roleplay both human prompt and AI responder to highlight AI's repetitive nature. The simple platform aims to poke fun at uninspired AI outputs.

headline: Don't overlook Elektron's budget music instruments.
summary: Elektron's Model:Samples and Model:Cycles are recommended for electronic music beginners. These grooveboxes offer great value, despite less mainstream attention. They provide a solid, budget-friendly entry into music production.

headline: Switched on Pop hosts share their love for music, vegetables, and gear.
summary: The 'Switched on Pop' podcast dissects pop songs and their musical theory. Hosts Nate Sloan and Charlie Harding are known for their deep dives into popular music. The article explores their creative process and personal interests.

headline: Disney not making 'The Hunt for Ben Solo' Star Wars movie.
summary: Lucasfilm president Dave Filoni confirmed the scrapped Star Wars project. Despite fan demand, 'The Hunt for Ben Solo' is not in development. The news was shared at D23 2026, disappointing some fans.

headline: Today's best deals: Project Hail Mary 4K, Resident Evil, AirPods Pro 3.
summary: Discover the top tech and entertainment deals available today. Offers include Project Hail Mary 4K Blu-ray and Resident Evil Requiem. Find discounts on popular electronics like AirPods Pro 3.

headline: X-Men director promises 'something new' for MCU reboot.
summary: X-Men director Jake Schreier hints at comic book influences for the MCU reboot. He aims to avoid recently overdone movie tropes and deliver a fresh take. Schreier discussed his vision with Marvel Studios at D23 2026.

headline: 'Dungeon Crawler Carl' TV series crucial for LitRPG adaptations.
summary: A TV series based on the popular 'Dungeon Crawler Carl' novel is in development. Its success could determine the future of LitRPG book-to-screen adaptations. The show carries high expectations to faithfully translate the genre.

headline: UK firefighters under 'incredible pressure' from major incidents.
summary: Multiple major incidents have been declared across England and Wales. Fire chiefs report immense strain on firefighters. Blazes in Stourbridge, Sandwell, and Pershore contribute to the crisis.

headline: PM calls Jason Arday's death 'tragedy on many levels'.
summary: The Prime Minister commented on the death of former Cambridge professor Jason Arday. Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham also expressed deep sorrow. The incident is described as a 'sad and sorry state of affairs'.

headline: 7.7 magnitude earthquake kills 47 in Indonesia.
summary: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck eastern Indonesia. At least 47 people have been confirmed dead on Flores island. Search and rescue operations are ongoing to find survivors.

headline: Met Police apologizes for data breach affecting Al Fayed victims.
summary: London's Metropolitan Police issued an apology for a data breach. Information was inadvertently shared with alleged Al Fayed victims. Scotland Yard accidentally copied all subscribers to a monthly update.
